tables.[Description]: One row per policy_number (G2), with an UNKNOWN member. gold.marine_dim_policy.
One row per imo_number (conformed: claim + policy IMOs; vessel_type from claims only - S3) (G2), with an UNKNOWN member. gold.marine_dim_vessel.
One row per customer_id (executive from claims - S4) (G2), with an UNKNOWN member. gold.marine_dim_customer.
One row per broker_id (TOBA master, MAR2-14a) (G2), with an UNKNOWN member. gold.marine_dim_broker.
One row per facility_id (G2), with an UNKNOWN member. gold.marine_dim_facility.
One row per claim_number (G2), with an UNKNOWN member. gold.marine_dim_claim.
Role-playing calendar (G6); the UNKNOWN row holds missing dates. gold.marine_dim_date.
Grain: One row per claim per vessel (claim_number, imo_number). gold.marine_fact_claim (G1). Rules: KPI-PAYMENT-RATIO, KPI-REPORTING-LAG, KPI-SETTLEMENT-RATIO, MAR2-09b.
Grain: One row per settlement movement (claim_number, last_transaction_date); imo_number splits multi-vessel groups. gold.marine_fact_claim_settlement_txn (G1).
Grain: One row per policy (policy_number). gold.marine_fact_policy (G1).

measures.[Description]: Number of policies, excluding the UNKNOWN member.
KPI-POLICY-DURATION: average of policy_duration_days; day counts are never summed.
KPI-POLICY-DURATION: minimum of policy_duration_days; day counts are never summed.
KPI-POLICY-DURATION: maximum of policy_duration_days; day counts are never summed.
KPI-WAR-RISK: policies where war_risk_included is TRUE; NULL is not counted.
Number of vessels, excluding the UNKNOWN member.
Number of customers, excluding the UNKNOWN member.
Number of brokers, excluding the UNKNOWN member.
Number of facilities, excluding the UNKNOWN member.
Number of claims, excluding the UNKNOWN member.
KPI-OPEN-REOPENED: claims where is_open_claim is TRUE; NULL is not counted.
KPI-OPEN-REOPENED: claims where is_reopened_claim is TRUE; NULL is not counted.
KPI-GA: claims where general_average_declared is TRUE; NULL is not counted.
Rows of Claim Vessels. Grain: One row per claim per vessel (claim_number, imo_number).
Currency check: claim_currency values in context. Money of Claim Vessels shows only when this is 1.
Sum of incurred_amount (ROW); blank unless one currency is in context; no FX.
Sum of paid_amount (ROW); blank unless one currency is in context; no FX.
Sum of salvage_amount (ROW); blank unless one currency is in context; no FX.
KPI-REPORTING-LAG: average of claim_reporting_lag_days; never summed.
KPI-REPORTING-LAG: minimum of claim_reporting_lag_days; never summed.
KPI-REPORTING-LAG: maximum of claim_reporting_lag_days; never summed.
KPI-PAYMENT-RATIO: DIVIDE(sum paid_amount, sum incurred_amount) over rows where the ratio is valid; never summed or averaged.
KPI-SETTLEMENT-RATIO: DIVIDE(sum _tmp_settlement_total, sum incurred_amount) over rows where the ratio is valid; never summed or averaged.
MAR2-09b: sum of paid_to_date; blank unless one currency is in context.
MAR2-09b: sum of outstanding_amount; blank unless one currency is in context.
Rows of Claim Vessels dated by Notification Date (inactive role).
Total Incurred dated by Notification Date; same currency rule.
Rows of Claim Settlement Transactions. Grain: One row per settlement movement (claim_number, last_transaction_date); imo_number splits multi-vessel groups.
Currency check: claim_currency values in context. Money of Claim Settlement Transactions shows only when this is 1.
Sum of settlement_amount (ROW); blank unless one currency is in context; no FX.
Rows of Policy Exposures. Grain: One row per policy (policy_number).
Currency check: currency values in context. Money of Policy Exposures shows only when this is 1.
Sum of limit_amount (ROW); blank unless one currency is in context; no FX.
Sum of premium_amount (ROW); blank unless one currency is in context; no FX.
Sum of insured_value_gbp (ROW); in GBP; never mixed.
Sum of gross_tonnage (ROW); not money.
Rows of Policy Exposures dated by Insurance Period End (inactive role).
Total Limit dated by Insurance Period End; same currency rule.
Rows of Policy Exposures dated by Policy Issue Date (inactive role).
Total Limit dated by Policy Issue Date; same currency rule.
